description: The clean run with a bare ap1-run: no --config, no --output-dir, so the runner reads example/config.json (edited as clean edits it) and writes to output/, its defaults. The golden output equals clean's.
scratch_copy: Runs in a scratch copy: with no options the runner reads example/config.json, which this scenario edits as clean does, and writes to the default output/; in the real tree that would change a tracked file and write into the published output/. It is the one full run of the defaults, which the real-tree scenarios replace with --config and --output-dir.
